purpose: Teach: コイツ/フラフラ/おととい/がまん/ちょこちょこ/まちまち/何時も/物凄く

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「コイツが俺の自慢の息子だ」って仰ってたわよ
lines.en: Your dad told me you're his greatest pride, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gaze soft but not searching. Passing on a compliment the way a mother does—without ceremony, like it's simply true. Slight pause before speaking, choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、運動会の後、フラフラだったよ
lines.en: Mom, I was so tired after the sports day.
lines.style: Small, quiet admission. Not complaining—observing about himself. Slightly uncertain, like he's checking if it was normal. Brief, genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おとといお祖父ちゃんがお見えになったのよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather came to visit the day before yesterday.
lines.style: Conversational mention, not demanding attention. The tone of someone sharing a detail she thinks he'd want to know. Gentle pace, no weight to it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、おやつをがまんしてからご飯食べるね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to skip my snack and eat dinner instead.
lines.style: Soft resolve in the voice. He's thought about this and made a decision. Not seeking praise—just telling her. The simplicity of a child being considerate without fanfare.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはちょこちょこ仕事の電話を取ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been taking work calls all day.
lines.style: Light observation, almost musing. Not explaining or excusing—just noticing aloud. The tone of someone used to this rhythm. Understated, not bitter.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達のお弁当の中身がまちまちで面白いよ
lines.en: Mom, all my friends have different things in their lunchboxes—it's so interesting.
lines.style: Brightening slightly. His curiosity landing on something small and real. Genuine delight in noticing differences. Conversational, eager to share the discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは何時もお仕事が忙しいのよね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's always busy with work, you know.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of the way things are. No frustration in the surface—just the patient recognition of a pattern. Slightly resigned but not sad. She's said this before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに会えて物凄く嬉しかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I was so happy to see Grandfather.
lines.style: Open warmth breaking through. Genuine, unguarded joy. The words come easier here. Slight brightness in the voice, lingering on the happiness like he wants to hold it.
